texts:
Thursday's practice reports are in, and Philadelphia lost its quarterback. Here is what moved for Week 6, team by team.

Jalen Hurts is ruled out.

David Montgomery is ruled out.

Mike Evans sat out Thursday.

Let's dive in.
#FlyEaglesFly #HTownMade #FTTB

Jalen Hurts is ruled out for Sunday with the calf, on the Eagles' report, after a full practice Wednesday. Tanner McKee starts.

Pivot to Tyler Shough, QB12 for me @NYG, a borderline start this week.
#FlyEaglesFly #Saints #NYGiants

Saquon Barkley missed practice Wednesday and Thursday with the hamstring. Monitor; Friday's injury report.

Dameon Pierce had 11 carries as the last healthy Eagles back in Week 5. RB30 for me, a high-end RB3.
#FlyEaglesFly

DeVonta Smith went from no practice Wednesday to limited Thursday with the hamstring. Monitor; Friday's injury report.

Dallas Goedert catches passes from Tanner McKee this week. TE10 for me.
#FlyEaglesFly

David Montgomery is ruled out with the groin and stays home from London.

Woody Marks played 56 of 65 snaps once Montgomery left at TEN. RB20 for me @JAX, an RB2.
#HTownMade #DUUUVAL

Tank Dell practiced in full Thursday but is ruled out and will not travel. WR110 rest of season for me. Drop him for any add on the list.

Nico Collins is WR8 for me @JAX.
#HTownMade #DUUUVAL

Mike Evans did not practice Thursday with the ribs and Achilles, per Kyle Shanahan. WR12 for me vs WAS, borderline WR1/WR2, for now. Monitor; Saturday's injury report.

Christian Kirk's IR window opened and he was limited. Monitor; his activation.
#FTTB #RaiseHail

Stefon Diggs did not practice Thursday with the hamstring, per Dan Quinn. Monitor; Saturday's injury report before Monday night.

Terry McLaurin is WR21 for me @SF, a WR2.
#RaiseHail #FTTB

Patrick Mahomes II moves up to QB9 for me vs LAC.

Rashee Rice missed practice again Thursday with the hamstring. WR27 for me, a high-end WR3, and a sit without a full practice Friday. Monitor; Friday's injury report.
#ChiefsKingdom #BoltUp

Ladd McConkey was limited Thursday with the foot. Outside my top 50 receivers @KC until he plays. Monitor; Friday's injury report.

Quentin Johnston was limited with the chest. WR44 rest of season for me. Monitor; Friday's designation.
#BoltUp #ChiefsKingdom

Chris Olave missed a second straight practice with the illness. WR6 for me @NYG for now. Monitor; Friday's injury report.

Alvin Kamara was limited again with the back. RB26 for me, a high-end RB3. Monitor; Friday's injury report.
#Saints #NYGiants

Isaiah Likely practiced in full Thursday with the foot. TE4 for me vs NO.

Malik Nabers saw 20 targets from Jameis Winston in Week 5. WR7 for me.
#NYGiants #Saints

Jeremiyah Love missed practice Wednesday and Thursday with the ankle. RB18 for me @LAR, an RB2, only if he practices Friday. Monitor; Friday's injury report.

Tyler Allgeier is the pivot if Love sits. RB36 for me, a low-end RB3.
#BirdGang #RamsHouse

Lamar Jackson missed practice again Thursday with the ankle, and Tyler Huntley starts if he sits. QB15 for me @CLE, a streamer. Monitor; Friday's injury report.

Zay Flowers was added as limited with a toe. WR9 for me.
#RavensFlock #DawgPound

Quinshon Judkins missed practice again with the ankle. RB33 for me vs BAL, a low-end RB3. Monitor; Friday's injury report.

Dylan Sampson was upgraded to limited off IR. Stash him, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB.
#DawgPound #RavensFlock

Caleb Williams practiced in full Thursday off the hamstring. QB8 for me @ATL.

Michael Penix Jr. was full with the ribs and starts vs CHI. QB21 for me, outside my top 12.
#DaBears #DirtyBirds

Breece Hall missed practice again with the quad.

Braelon Allen played all but two snaps without Hall in Week 4. RB19 for me @NE, an RB2.

A.J. Brown was limited Thursday, still on IR. Monitor; his activation before NYJ.
#JetUp #NEPats

Rico Dowdle practiced in full Thursday with the toe, and Mike McCarthy still calls Jaylen Warren the featured back. Warren is RB6 for me @TB.

Baker Mayfield missed practice again with the thumb. Jalon Daniels is QB27 for me, outside my top 12.
#HereWeGo #GoBucs

Tyjae Spears missed Thursday's practice with the knee. RB40 for me, a low-end flex play to a dart throw.

Tony Pollard is RB21 for me @IND, an RB2.

Josh Downs practiced in full. WR23 for me vs TEN, a WR2.
#TitanUp #ForTheShoe

Seattle plays @DEN tonight at 8:15 PM ET, and Pat Surtain II is out for Denver.

Jaxon Smith-Njigba practiced in full this week. WR2 for me.

J.K. Dobbins is RB27 for me, a high-end RB3.
#Seahawks #BroncosCountry

Every note from today is on the Pass, with Friday's final injury reports next.

Follow @FF_ChefHazy for Friday's calls, and repost this for your league.
